app.name: Ma'ālim
app.tagline: A calm, guided path for new Muslims

banner.unverified: UNVERIFIED CONTENT — development only, never shown to learners

map.title: Your path
map.intro: Six landmarks. Take them in order, at your own pace.
map.allDone: You have finished every landmark. Well done.

learn.title: Learn
learn.empty: Choose a landmark on the map to start a unit.
learn.reviewBody: A few answers here were tricky. A short review can help.

practise.title: Practise
practise.empty: Practice items will appear here once they have been reviewed.
practise.doneBody: Take your time. You can repeat any item whenever you like.
practise.emptyHint: Nothing to practise yet: items appear here only after a reviewer has approved them.

me.title: Me
me.privacy: Nothing is stored about you on our servers. Your progress stays on this device.
me.stage: Where are you in your journey?
me.stageHint: You choose this, and you can change it at any time. It stays on this device.
me.shareHint: Off by default. If you turn it on, only counts like "a unit was finished" are shared with mentors to improve the course. Never your name or answers.
me.reset: Clear my progress on this device
me.resetConfirm: Clear everything on this device? This cannot be undone.

common.errorBody: This page could not load. Your progress is safe on this device.
common.notFoundBody: We could not find that page.

unit.buildsOn: This landmark builds on: {list}. You can still open it.
unit.notFound: We could not find this landmark.
unit.objectives: What you will be able to do

pending.label: Waiting for review
pending.body: This part is being prepared and reviewed by our content team. It is not shown until it has been checked.

video.permission: We are waiting for the creator's permission to show this clip.
video.missingFile: This clip has not been added yet.
video.missingCaptions: Captions are not ready yet, so the clip is not shown.

item.tryAgain: Not quite. Here is what the source says:
item.orderHint: Put the steps in order, then check.

explain.generatedNote: Every sentence comes from a verified source. Tap a number to read the source.
explain.verbatimNote: Showing the verified source text exactly as published.

admin.title: Review queue
admin.intro: Approve or reject draft practice items. An item can be approved only if it passes the automatic checks.
admin.unauthorized: Enter the access token to continue.
admin.explanationsHint: Every sentence already cites a verified passage. Reject an explanation to show the verbatim source instead.

ask.title: Ask a question
ask.intro: Type your question. We answer only from verified sources, and for anything else we can pass it to a person.
ask.label: Your question
ask.placeholder: For example: What are the steps of wudu?
ask.notFound: We could not find this in our verified sources.
ask.notReady: We have not finished reviewing sources for this topic yet.
ask.citationNote: We always answer with sources, never without.
ask.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
ask.referDefault: This question needs a person to look at it with you. We do not answer it ourselves. We can pass it to a mentor.
ask.urgentDefault: It sounds like things are heavy right now. You deserve support from a real person. If you may be in danger, please contact local emergency services or someone you trust right now.
ask.noRulings: We never give personal rulings or fatwas.

handoff.title: Before we send anything
handoff.intro: This is exactly what a mentor will see. You can change it. Nothing is sent until you press Send.
handoff.privacy: Please do not write your name, phone number, email or links. We do not store who you are.
handoff.sentBody: A mentor will look at this. Your reference code is {code}. Keep it if you want to mention it later.
handoff.identifier: Please remove contact details (email, phone number or links) and try again.
handoff.failed: We could not send it. Please try again.
handoff.question: Question

mentor.title: Mentor dashboard
mentor.intro: Referrals the learners chose to send, and anonymised counts. No names, no contact details.
mentor.suppressed: Counts below 3 are hidden so no one can be singled out.

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.body: Take your time. Learn at your own pace, with real clips and sources you can check. Nothing is stored about you on our servers.
